The tree is therefore NOT commit 9bc9c387 alone; the build source-tree digest below binds the exact bytes that were measured and built. The release commit a0aca565 contains those bytes: the publish receipt records the packaging-tree digest at a0aca565 as identical to the build tree.

The publish receipt records that the release commit a0aca565 carries exactly these bytes, and the packaging-tree digest recomputed at a0aca565 is unchanged at 9b72d872…, which binds these artefact hashes to the released source.
